settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Every WRYDECO piece is handcrafted from solid natural wood, shaped by skilled artisans into functional art that is timeless, enduring, and deeply connected to nature.
settings.hero_image_alt: Handcrafted solid wood console styled with natural branches and ceramic objects
settings.consultation_card_text: Our team is happy to help with materials, sizing, timelines or anything specific to your project.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: For most standard orders delivered to eligible destinations worldwide, allow approximately 18 to 25 business days in total. That is roughly 15 to 20 business days of processing and production, followed by roughly 3 to 5 business days in transit. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays. Oversized, customized, or specially handled pieces may need longer, and any product-specific lead time shown on the product page or in your written agreement takes precedence.

settings.question: Why does production take as long as it does?
settings.answer: Because your piece does not exist yet when you order it. Processing covers material selection, production coordination, hand shaping and joinery, finishing, quality checks, and protective packing. The clock starts once your payment is authorised and any customization details or approvals have been confirmed. Before packing, we send final photos or video for your confirmation, so replying quickly to our questions and approvals is the single best way to keep your timeline short.

settings.question: Is shipping included, and who delivers it?
settings.answer: Complimentary standard shipping is included on all orders accepted for delivery to eligible addresses worldwide, with no minimum order value. We coordinate through third-party logistics partners and select the carrier based on the piece, its dimensions and weight, the destination, and the handling required. Optional expedited, specialized, installation, storage, redelivery, or other additional services may carry a separate charge, always confirmed with you beforehand.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You will receive an order confirmation by email as soon as your order is placed, and a shipping confirmation with tracking details once the piece leaves us — tracking can take some time to become active on the carrier side. If your confirmation has not arrived, check the spam folder first, then write to support@wrydeco.com with your order number.

settings.question: Can you deliver outside the United States?
settings.answer: Yes. WRYDECO offers worldwide shipping to eligible destinations where checkout, carrier coverage, destination accessibility, and logistical requirements allow. International orders may be subject to customs clearance, import duties, taxes, destination-specific restrictions, or additional handling requirements. If your address has unusual access conditions, contact us before placing your order so we can confirm what is realistic.

settings.question: When am I charged, and is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Payment is taken at checkout. The transaction is handled by Shopify secure payment infrastructure, so your card details are never visible to or stored by us. Processing of your order begins once payment has been authorised or completed and all required shipping, contact, and specification details are in place.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: Contact support@wrydeco.com immediately. Because pieces are made to order, what remains possible depends on how far yours has progressed — a change requested before your specifications reach the workshop is very different from one requested after the wood has been selected and cut. Tell us as soon as you know and we will be straight with you about the options.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange a piece?
settings.answer: No. All WRYDECO purchases are final sale and non-exchangeable. We cannot accept returns for a change of mind, an incorrect product or size selection, a finish or style preference, or a piece that does not fit your space after delivery. Custom, personalized, made-to-order, and special-order pieces are never eligible. If you are uncertain about size, finish, or suitability, ask us before you order rather than after.

settings.question: My piece arrived damaged or incorrect. What should I do?
settings.answer: Contact us within 30 calendar days of delivery with your order number, a clear description of the issue, photographs of the piece, all packaging, the shipping label, and any visible damage. Include video evidence where the issue is best demonstrated by video. We will review the claim and provide an appropriate resolution, which may be a repair, replacement part, replacement, partial refund, or full refund depending on the case. Please do not return anything until we have given you written instructions.

settings.question: Can I order a piece in a custom size?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. On the product page, choose the Custom option under size and describe the dimensions you need. That submits a request to our team rather than an order, so nothing is charged while we assess feasibility, lead time, and price. For a piece designed from scratch rather than resized, start with a consultation instead.

settings.question: Can I request a wood finish that is not listed?
settings.answer: Yes. Each product page shows the finishes available for that design, and a Custom colour option lets you upload a reference image of the tone you are trying to match. We will tell you honestly whether it can be achieved in natural wood — some tones simply cannot be reached without hiding the grain, and we will say so rather than guess.

settings.question: What wood is used, and will my piece match the photographs?
settings.answer: Solid natural wood, selected for grain, form, and structural suitability for each design. The material and finish specified for your piece are stated on its product page or in your proposal. The design and proportions will match the photographs; the wood itself will not. Grain, tone, knots, texture, and organic edges vary from board to board, and those differences are the character of the work rather than a fault in it.

settings.question: How do I care for my piece, and can it be restored later?
settings.answer: Dust with a soft dry cloth, wipe spills promptly, and avoid abrasive pads, harsh chemicals, and standing moisture. Keep the piece out of sustained direct sunlight and away from heating vents or sharp humidity swings. Solid wood can usually be maintained or professionally restored years later — send us photographs before applying any oil, wax, filler, or stripper so we can advise based on the original finish.

settings.question: Can I speak to someone before I buy, and do you work with designers?
settings.answer: Yes to both. A private consultation is complimentary before you order, runs 30 minutes, and carries no obligation to purchase. Slots are offered daily at 9AM, 1PM, and 8PM Asia/Saigon time, bookable up to a week ahead with at least three hours notice, and a senior designer is assigned to your project. We also work with interior designers and studios on specifications, custom sizing, finish matching, and project timelines for residential and boutique commercial work. You can reach us any time at support@wrydeco.com, with a response within 24 hours.

settings.question: Who actually makes these pieces?
settings.answer: WRYDECO is a US-operated furniture brand. Our pieces are handcrafted by skilled artisans in Vietnam, where shaping, joinery, finishing, and inspection are carried out by people rather than a production line. Our online support team coordinates questions, custom details, production updates, and delivery support.

settings.question: How does a full bespoke commission work?
settings.answer: It starts with a complimentary consultation: your room, rough dimensions, the product type you have in mind, budget range, timeline, and any references. We then define the scope and quote the project individually. Commissioned work sits above our standard pieces in both lead time and price, and you approve the specification and quotation before production begins. Before packing, we send final photos or video for your confirmation.

settings.question: Is there a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes. WRYDECO pieces carry a 5-year warranty covering structural integrity — the joinery and construction that hold the piece together. It does not cover the natural movement, tonal shift, and surface patina that solid wood develops over time, or damage from misuse, unsuitable environments, or alterations made after delivery. Contact us with photographs if you believe something structural has failed.
